newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesian rubber unchanged in late trading.
newsitem.headline: Indonesian rubber unchanged in late trading.

text.p: Indonesian SIR20 rubber offer prices were unchanged in late trading on Monday amid an absence of buyers, traders said.
"We didn't see any traders come to the market today. Everything is very quiet...there is no energy at all to trade because nobody is buying our rubber," said one trader.
Traders said no bids were heard in the afternoon and market sentiment was weak for the rest of the day.
They said offer prices were heard at 48.625 U.S. cents/lb fob Medan, 48.50 fob Surabaya and Medan, 48.25 fob Jambi and at 48.00 fob Pontianak.
